result.brief: 提出 Touch-JEPA，用视频自监督掩码特征预测学习手-物交互触觉表征，并以少量触觉监督联合训练，实现接触与触觉强度估计的跨手迁移。
result.reason: JEPA-style masked visual feature prediction from hand-object video yields transferable tactile/contact representations; a self-supervised video representation contribution, though not generative world modeling.
